issuerHelp: Applications send users to this address to sign in with Gately. It must be reachable through one of Gately's listeners with an HTTPS certificate covering the domain; no site is needed for it. Scheme, domain and port only.
discoveryHelp: Most applications only need this address (Discovery URL, Auto Discovery URL or Issuer URL) plus the client's Client ID and Client Secret.
scopesHelp: Supported scopes: openid, profile, email, groups, offline_access (confidential clients only). ID tokens are signed with RS256; PKCE (S256) is supported.
publicHelp: For single-page apps and mobile apps that cannot keep a secret: no secret, PKCE required, no refresh tokens
confidentialHelp: Server-side applications authenticate with the Client Secret, e.g. Gitea, OpenList, Grafana
secretPlaceholder: At least 16 characters, or click Generate
secretOnce: Only a hash of the secret is kept after saving and it cannot be shown again. Copy it into the application first
redirectHelp: Must match the redirect_uri sent by the application exactly. If it is wrong, sign-in stops at an error page that shows the address the application actually sent, ready to copy.
allowPlaceholder: One username per line, or group:name
allowHelp: Leave empty to let every shared user sign in to this application. Users are matched by name, so update this list after renaming a user. Groups are set on shared users
secretUnsaved: New secret not saved yet, copy it first
allowAll: All shared users can sign in
applyHelp: Click OK to return to Global settings; changes take effect after you save Global settings.
idDuplicate: Client ID "{id}" is already used by another client
